verdict.rationale: Pulley documents drafting SAFEs from standard YC templates and collecting board and investor e-signatures in-platform without a third-party tool. Its cap table has dedicated SAFE and Convertible Note tabs, and fundraising modeling produces pro-formas for a SAFE or priced round. missing for 10: explicit documentation that executed SAFEs flow automatically onto the cap table, detail on how conversion terms (cap/discount/MFN) are modeled, evidence of in-platform convertible note creation and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
